# SOUNDTEST.PRO

> Professional online sound level meter and environmental noise evidence documentation platform. Zero-installation, browser-based acoustic analysis with real-time dBA/dBC decibel metering, 1/3-octave frequency spectrum, GPS location tagging, and tamper-evident SHA-256 sealed CSV and PDF evidence reporting for noise dispute documentation.

SOUNDTEST.PRO operates entirely client-side in modern web browsers (mobile and desktop) utilizing high-precision Web Audio API digital signal processing, MediaStream Recording API, and Geolocation API. It requires no app store installation, safeguards user privacy with local processing, and produces structured acoustic documentation dossiers.

## Core Capabilities
- [Real-Time Sound Meter](https://soundtest.pro/): High-precision Web Audio API decibel estimation with IEC 61672-1 modeled A-weighting (dBA), C-weighting (dBC), and Z-weighting (dBZ), Fast (125 ms) and Slow (1000 ms) time response, and real-time peak hold.
- [Sentry Surveillance Workstation](https://soundtest.pro/): Background unattended noise event monitoring with impulse trigger detection and automatic audio incident capture.
- [Tamper-Evident Evidence Sealing](https://soundtest.pro/samples/): Cryptographic SHA-256 digest calculation for both media recordings and structured JSON/CSV metadata (schema: `soundtest.pro-evidence-manifest-v1`, evidence ID: `STP-YYYYMMDD-XXXXX`).
- [Forensic PDF Dossier Generator](https://soundtest.pro/samples/): In-browser generation of multi-page PDF reports containing Leq exceedance charts, GPS accuracy radius, and device environment logs.

## Noise Dispute Scenarios & Field Guides
- [Upstairs Neighbor Noise Evidence](https://soundtest.pro/use-cases/neighbor-noise-evidence/): Comprehensive methodologies for capturing ceiling footstep stomping, bass vibrations, and recurring nocturnal impact noise for landlord complaints, HOA mediation, or police reporting.
- [Nightlife & Bar Disturbance](https://soundtest.pro/use-cases/bar-street-disturbance/): Monitoring commercial bass resonance, outdoor patio disturbances, and municipal noise curfew violations through residential windows.
- [Construction Noise Monitoring](https://soundtest.pro/use-cases/construction-noise-monitoring/): Documenting heavy machinery operations, early-morning start times, and property boundary decibel limits.
- [Property & HOA Disputes](https://soundtest.pro/use-cases/property-noise-complaint-report/): Compiling chronological acoustic dossiers to overcome HOA and building management inaction.
- [Tenant Lease Break Defense](https://soundtest.pro/use-cases/rental-dispute-evidence/): Proving breach of the covenant of quiet enjoyment to terminate unlivable rental leases without financial penalty.
- [Workplace Noise Safety](https://soundtest.pro/use-cases/workplace-noise-inspection/): Tracking industrial noise exposure levels against ISO 1999 and OSHA Permissible Exposure Limits (PEL).

## Reference Guides & Technical Documentation
- [Decibel Reference Chart & Noise Standards](https://soundtest.pro/noise-levels/): Ambient decibel thresholds across residential, commercial, and industrial zones according to WHO, EPA, and GB 3096 guidelines.
- [Measurement Accuracy & Calibration](https://soundtest.pro/accuracy/): Transparent breakdown of smartphone MEMS microphone acoustic physical limits, frequency curves, and calibration procedures.
- [Sample Evidence Dossiers](https://soundtest.pro/samples/): Downloadable sample bundles including CSV time-series logs, PDF reports, and SHA-256 JSON custody manifests.
- [Standards & Compliance Reference](https://soundtest.pro/standards/): IEC 61672-1 digital acoustic weighting algorithms and ISO 266 1/3-octave band specifications.

## Acoustic Standards & Engineering Precision
- Standardized Signal Processing: Built in strict adherence to digital acoustic filtering models defined in IEC 61672-1 (Frequency Weighting & Time Weighting) and ISO 266 (Preferred frequencies for 1/3-octave band analysis).
- Verifiable Chain of Custody: Hardware profiling, UTC timestamping, GPS accuracy fencing, and cryptographic SHA-256 hashing ensure unalterable digital proof of acoustic events.
- Objective Data Dossiers: Produces arbitration-grade structured evidence dossiers designed for landlord negotiations, property hearings, police complaints, and tenant dispute defense.
